provider.note: The two committed repository workflow files below declare the candidate required-check names (sourceKind committed-workflow-files, locally verifiable at any HEAD). Presence does not qualify the runtime CI actor, a current candidate, protected policy or required checks. requiredChecks.registrationStatus stays UNSELECTED until platform-admin registration and authorized P4_1 execution; the remote enforcement of these names stays UNVERIFIED (repository-registration.json#branchProtection.remoteEnforcement, pendingOwner P4_1). A check-run name is the workflow job's name, defaulting to the job id.

declaredCandidateChecks.note: Candidate set declared by the committed workflow files (provider.committedWorkflows), registered 2026-10-26 revision 2026-10-26-comet-050-adoption-v1. This is a local declaration of candidate names only: it is not an admin registration, not a platform-enforced protection claim, and never satisfies PLATFORM_REQUIRED_CHECK_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED.

binding.description: Every required check's evidence must be bound to the exact integration merge SHA of the candidate; a new head/mergeSHA must never reuse an older check's evidence (STALE_EVIDENCE blocks promotion).

requiredChecks.evidenceRule: Protected-check history is preserved; after a restore, old evidence can never authorize a new SHA (infra/delivery/platform/artifact-retention.json#rollbackRetention). QUEUED extends the contract floor for this revision: a check or build that has not finished (queued/in-progress) is never success evidence.

authorization.writerOwner: Platform policy writes belong to the existing P tasks and the Comet closeout authorization; the real P4_1 gate stays with the platform.
authorization.basis: infrastructure-plan.md I06: this stage is design/read-only verification only; the admin identity is not this run approval to modify branch protection, so configuring required checks must be refused.
